events.title: Rosalind Discovery added + GPT-5.6 Sol promo expiry revealed (Nov 21)
events.detail: New model gpt-rosalind-discovery ($5/$25, same as Research). GPT-5.6 Sol promotional pricing 'available at least through November 21, 2026' — potentially a third price increase event in the Nov-Jan window.

events.title: Gemini 4 Argon pricing published: $2/$10 promo, doubles Dec 1 (+100%)
events.detail: Google published Argon pricing after initially showing 'Not available'. Introductory rates: $2 input / $10 output / $0.10 cache through Nov 30. All rates double Dec 1 — one month BEFORE the Gemini 3.x Jan 1 doubling. Two consecutive price increases in 31 days.

events.title: Gemini 4 Argon added (no public pricing yet)
events.detail: Flagship reasoning model, enterprise-only at launch. Official pricing page shows 'Not available'. Will update when Google publishes rates.

events.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 added ($0.10/$0.50 — cheapest Claude ever)
events.detail: Ultra-budget tier with long-context split at 100K tokens (>100K: $2.50/$1.00). 10x cheaper than Haiku 4.5.

events.title: Comparison pages launched (+3)
events.detail: Head-to-head cost comparisons with workload calculator: GPT-6 Sol vs 5.6 Sol, GPT-6 Astra vs Luna (100x gap), Gemini 3.8 Flash vs 3.1 Pro — triggered by comparison queries forming in search autocomplete.

events.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash removed from official pricing page
events.detail: Google delisted 3.7 Flash from ai.google.dev pricing (3.8 and 3.6 remain at $0.75/$3.75 promo). Likely retired — page kept with historical rates and deprecation banner.

events.title: LLMPrices.org launched
events.detail: Site launched with Gemini 3.8/3.7/3.6 Flash and Claude Opus 5, Sonnet 5, Opus 4, Sonnet 4 pricing, tracked from official docs.

events.title: Anthropic lineup completed (+9 models)
events.detail: Added Opus 5.5 ($4/$20), Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 ($10/$50), Haiku 4.5 ($1/$5), and the Opus 4.5–4.8 / Sonnet 4.5–4.6 line.

events.title: Opus 4.5–4.8 repriced: $15/$75 → $5/$25 (-67%)
events.detail: Per Anthropic docs, the late Opus 4 generation now lists at $5/$25 per MTok — a 67% cut vs Opus 4/4.1 launch pricing.

events.title: Gemini side expanded (+5 models)
events.detail: Added 3.1 Pro (tiered ≤/>200k), 3.5/3.1 Flash-Lite, 3.8 Flash TTS and Omni Flash (video ≈$0.10/sec).

events.title: DeepSeek added (Flash + V4 Pro)
events.detail: Flash $0.30/$1.20 and V4 Pro $1.32/$3.96 at peak, with off-peak 50% discounts and cache-hit input at $0.006/$0.044.

events.title: GPT-6 family added (+7 models)
events.detail: GPT-6 Astra ($10/$50), Sol ($2/$10), Luna ($0.10/$0.50), plus GPT-5.6 Sol/Cyber, 5.3 Codex and Rosalind Research. Batch = 50%, Priority = 2x.

events.title: Public API + llms.txt
events.detail: Launched free JSON API (/api/v1/prices), llms.txt index and FAQ/WebSite structured data.

events.title: Gemini 3.x promo expires: prices double (+100%)
events.detail: Per Google's official pricing page, promotional rates for Gemini 3.6/3.7/3.8 Flash double on Jan 1, 2027: $0.75/$3.75 → $1.50/$7.50.

events.title: Grok lineup added (+5 models)
events.detail: Grok 4.7/4.6 ($2/$6), 4.5 ($2/$6, cheaper cache), 4.3 ($1.25/$2.50) and Build 0.1 ($1/$2), with cached-read and 2x long-context rates from docs.x.ai.

events.title: Qwen hosted pricing added (+4 models)
events.detail: Qwen3.8-27B (¥3/¥12), 3.6-27B, 3.5-122B and 3.5-35B — hosted rates on SiliconFlow, CNY per 1M tokens. Llama deferred (not listed on the captured source).

events.title: Qwen prices switched to international USD rates
events.detail: Replaced CN-platform CNY rates with SiliconFlow international USD pricing: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B $2/$6 (cached $0.25), 3.6-27B $0.3/$3.2, 3.5-122B $0.26/$2.08, 3.6-35B $0.24/$1.8. CN platform still bills CNY — noted on each page.

events.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 added ($2/$10)
events.detail: Newest Sonnet generation at unchanged Sonnet 5 rates — capability upgrade at no extra cost.

events.title: GPT-6.1 Sol added ($2/$10)
events.detail: 6.1 generation of the Sol workhorse, same headline rates as 6.0: $2/$10, cached $0.10, batch $1/$5, long-context 2x.
